versions.changelog:
Version 1.2.6 refocuses the skill around safer, more practical screen tasks and reusable workflow delivery.

- Clarifies when to handle a task directly versus build a reusable workflow, with guidance for using visual, accessibility, browser, and external-tool capabilities.
- Strengthens user-in-the-loop safeguards for credentials, authentication, payments, and other high-risk actions.
- Adds workflow references for Agent phases, lifecycle, trust boundaries, current-task operations, and user guidance.
- Updates workflow development and delivery guidance, including validation, bounded recovery, stopping behavior, and first-run instructions.
- Removes the obsolete skill-card.md file.

- Added a new section on combinable workflow capabilities, clarifying support for Agent integration, file generation, external tool calls, and related capabilities introduced in later desktop assistant versions.
- Updated SOP and usage guidance to reflect new abilities and recommend checking real SDK interfaces before answering about limitations.
- Improved instructions for handling optional components, their activation, and user guidance for installing or activating extensions.
- Removed the sample file skill-card.md.

Screen Automation Engineer 1.2.0 introduces enhanced browser integration and workflow flexibility.

- Added support for browser enhancement testing (see new reference).
- Expanded browser task handling: can now directly use browser CLI for one-off tasks; improved recommendations for browser-enhanced actions on supported platforms.
- Updated workflow standards: clarified when and how to use browser, UIA, and screen actions.
- Refined clipboard and sensitive data handling; clarified boundaries for copying/selection actions.
- Improved compatibility logic for optional extensions and SDK discovery.
- Removed outdated documentation; revised references and engineering standards.

- Updated metadata structure in SKILL.md, adding explicit multilingual displayName and description fields.
- Refined and streamlined the introductory and instruction text in SKILL.md for improved clarity.
- Adjusted SOP and engineering standards language for greater conciseness, without changing functional guidance.
- Removed legacy documentation file skill-card.md.

Version 1.1.28

- Major update: streamlined file structure, updated skill definition, and aligned process with new atomic capabilities.
- Refactored and condensed SKILL.md, emphasizing agent roles, sources of truth, safety boundaries, and new CLI conventions.
- Replaced legacy scripts with platform-resolving wrappers (`resolve_cli.ps1`, `resolve_cli.sh`) for accurate local CLI location.
- Workflow, reference, and agent-bridge standards are now externally linked for dedicated atomic compliance.
- Removed deprecated files, obsolete workflows, and legacy manifest content for consistency with the new standard.
No changes detected in this version.

screen-automation-engineer v0.1.2

- Updated SKILL.md to version 1.1.9 with clarified and expanded documentation, especially for mouse scroll support and corresponding CLI/Python SDK usage.
- Added detailed section on mouse scroll (horizontal/vertical) capability queries and instructions for both Windows and macOS.
- Improved workflow development guidelines, ensuring CLI contract consistency between Windows and macOS.
- Removed the obsolete skill-card.md file.
- General documentation enhancements and workflow standard clarifications.

- Added explicit end-user feedback workflow: after user consents, opens help center feedback form for review and manual submission; disallows automated submission or pre-filling contact info.
- Clarified: must not use background requests or autofill in feedback; users must review and submit feedback themselves.
- Removed file: skill-card.md.
- Documentation and workflow standards updated for clarity on user control, feedback, and consent.

屏幕自动化工程师 1.1.4 版本重大升级：规范本地屏幕自动化流程开发，增强端侧控制和开发标准。

- 全面规定 Windows/macOS 双平台本地屏幕识别、窗口控制和自动化流程开发流程。
- 引入严格的开发与验证流水线，强制读取工作标准文件，严格对齐真实桌面端能力。
- 明确分工：Agent 负责理解和规划，小助手执行本地视觉与自动化操作。
- 支持按自然语言创建和维护流程，现仅需一次性完成任务时可直接对话操作。
- 强化执行前确认、安全边界和操作后验证，防止误操作和越权自动化。
- 统一面向用户表达，避免技术名词，保障隐私和安全。
